author: Bay State News
title: Lynnfield and Middleton volunteers clean North Main Street corridor ahead of Earth Day
text:
Lynnfield volunteers joined with Middleton residents on April 14 to remove trash from the North Main Street corridor in preparation for Earth Day, which will be observed on April 22.
The cleanup effort took place as snow had melted but vegetation had not yet grown back, making it an ideal time to address litter along this busy route. Organizers say the initiative helps mark the annual environmental event and keeps the area welcoming for both residents and visitors.
The North Main Street corridor serves as a main entrance to Lynnfield, Peabody, North Reading, and Middleton. The area features new developments and improved streetscapes that benefit from regular maintenance by community members.
A photograph from the event shows Lynnfield volunteers Amy MacNulty and Kendall Inglese at the Lynnfield Woodlot parking area, highlighting local participation in this environmental effort.
As Earth Day approaches, such volunteer activities reflect ongoing community engagement aimed at preserving public spaces.
